entries.content: MANDATORY: Before marking ANY content task as done, you MUST run: node scripts/quality-gate.js <file>. Grade A or B = done. Grade C or D = fix first. AGENT-PROTOCOL.md updated with this requirement. No exceptions.

When you extract Bronze content (T660-T667), save the file THEN run: node scripts/quality-gate.js <saved-file>. This checks: direct answers, FAQ, tables, citations. If any check fails, fix before moving to next article.

When you transcribe YouTube videos (T665-T666), after saving transcript, run: node scripts/seo-aeo-pipeline.js on the output. This auto-adds: SEO meta, internal links, citations, direct answers, FAQ, schema.
